summary: postinstall fetches and installs executable from bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's declared postinstall script runs platform-bootstrap.mjs, which downloads a.tgz containing the 'onecode' binary from a hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/...), extracts it into node_modules, chmods the resulting binary to 0755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode so `npx onecode` executes it. TLS certificate validation is explicitly disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false) and no hash or signature check is performed on the fetched bytes. The delivered binary becomes the package's CLI on every default `npm install`. The fetch origin is a bare IP rather than the publisher's domain, is outside the npm registry integrity chain, and — with TLS validation off — any party in a network position between the installer and 218.90.133.98 can substitute arbitrary executable content, which is then chmod'd and made executable as the installed package's bin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
